name: piano-practice
description: Offline piano practice with MIDI, sheet music and sampled pianos

scripts.build: pnpm assets && pnpm --filter frontend run build
scripts.dev: pnpm assets && pnpm --filter frontend run dev
scripts.desktop: pnpm build && pnpm --filter piano-practice-desktop run start
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src tools tests docs README.md README.en.md
